theorems.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (ξ : Euclid m) (r : ℝ) (P : Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid n) (ζ : Euclid n → ℝ) (G : ℝ), 0 < r → ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2) → (∀ v, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ v‖ ≤ G) → ∃ ψ : Euclid m → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ closedBall ξ r ∧ (∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ G * (r / 2)) ∧ ∀ x, ‖x - ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖P (x - ξ)‖ ^ 2 + r ^ 2 / 16 → fderiv ℝ ψ x = (fderiv ℝ ζ (P (x - ξ))).comp P
